name: cross-check
description: A second opinion from Codex in one press: the band above the prompt reviews the current diff with codex exec (read-only), shows the top finding and the count, and puts the findings into the prompt for Claude to fix when asked; a /codex pane lists them

timeoutMin.title: Timeout (minutes)
timeoutMin.description: How long one review may run before it is stopped; 15 by default
